purpose: Paid-social test priority in the specified country, not generic attractiveness or a profitability forecast.

components.guidance: Reward a product understood in under 3 seconds, a visual demonstration, an obvious pain and an impulse-friendly paid-social offer. Penalize education, installation, sizing, technical setup and heavy trust-building.

Use current target-country seller, review, search/shopping and plausibly transferable source-market ad evidence. Zero exact-query ads is not low-demand proof; seller availability alone is not verified purchasing.

Reward room for a differentiated offer amid demonstrated target-market demand. Penalize overcrowding, price clustering and near-identical sellers. If competition appears absent and demand is unproven, do not exceed 6.
Use target-market retail-price proxies for room above commodity pricing. Penalize low-price white-label competition. Do not invent supplier cost, margin, acquisition cost or profitability.

Reward repeated creative testing evidence, clear hooks, problem-solution messaging and target-market-safe angles. Distinct repeated creatives are stronger evidence than duration alone. A media URL alone is not an observed demonstration.

Reward small, durable, non-fragile, easy-to-ship, low-support and low-return-risk products. Penalize sizing, setup, breakage, leakage, batteries, bulk and support burden; do not invent shipping rates or return statistics.

Score conservatively using current applicable official sources. Reward low apparent legality, safety, claim and platform-policy risk, not an assertion of legal compliance. Penalize regulated categories, restrictions and unresolved hazards.

priority_bands.meaning: Weak / only test if pipeline is thin

calculation_order: Select supported integer bands; choose the lower band when between bands.
Apply component ceilings and publish the capped component values.
Sum all seven capped components without additional weighting.
Take the minimum of that sum and every applicable final-score cap.
Assign the priority band from the capped final score.

evidence_confidence.meaning: Evidence quality, not product quality; reduce for thin, conflicting, stale, indirect, cross-country or failed research. No quantitative confidence formula was provided.

implementation_note: Cap IDs are reporting conventions. Point bands, ceilings and priority cutoffs preserve the approved scoring policy. Do not infer new statistical calibration from them.
